import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def add(a, b):
    return (a + b) % MOD

def main():
    n = int(sys.stdin.readline().strip())
    dp = [0] * 1010
    dp[0] = 1
    result = 0
    for i in range(n + 1):
        for j in range(i, n + 1):
            if (i + j) % 2 == 1:
                result = add(result, dp[j])
            dp[j + 1] = add(dp[j + 1], dp[j])
    print(result)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
